title: Backend Software Engineer
text:
Globex is hiring a Backend Software Engineer to build reliable APIs at scale.

What you'll do:
- Design and implement REST APIs using Python and FastAPI.
- Work with PostgreSQL and Redis for storage and caching.
- Write tests and participate in code reviews.

What we're looking for:
- 2+ years of backend development experience.
- Proficiency in Python; familiarity with SQL databases.
- Experience deploying services with Docker and Kubernetes.
- Good communication and teamwork.

Nice to have:
- Experience with AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
- Knowledge of CI pipelines.

Note: Globex is a sample company; this posting is synthetic and used only for TailorVoice demos.
